🎴 Feature & Item Cards

"The rogue laminated Sneak Attack. The DM laminated the trap."

Print a character's attacks, class features, and race traits as cut-out cards, with any SRD magic item beside them, so the rules sit on the table instead of in a book.

✨ Magic items

    On the cards

      🎴 Cards

      Poker-size cards (2.5 × 3.5 in, 63 × 88 mm), nine to a page with dashed lines to cut along. Print at 100% scale (not "fit to page"). An item too long for one card carries on to the next.

      Characters come from the Character Builder and stay in this browser; this page only reads them. The magic items you pick live in the address bar, so 🔗 Copy Link shares them.
      Class features, traits, and weapon rules are short summaries in the Gazette's own words. Magic item text is from the System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

      Cards at the table

      A character sheet holds everything, which is why nobody can find anything on it mid-fight. Cards pull out the parts you use: each attack with its bonus and damage worked out, each feature with its numbers filled in for your level, and each magic item with its full text. Lay them out in front of you, turn a card sideways when a once-per-rest feature is spent, and hand an item's card to whoever carries it.

      What's on each card

      • ⚔️ Attacks: one per weapon you carry, plus your unarmed strike and a dragonborn's breath weapon. To hit and damage come from your scores, proficiency, and fighting style; the card gives the reach or range and what the weapon's properties do.
      • 📘 Class features: everything your class gives you up to your level, with your choices (fighting style, metamagic, invocations, and the rest) and any feat.
      • 🧬 Race traits and your 🎒 background feature.
      • ✨ Magic items: any of the 348 SRD items, colored by rarity, with an A when it needs attunement. A long item keeps going on a second card marked 2/2.

      Printing

      Pick Letter or A4, print at 100%, and cut along the dashed lines. The cards are the size of a standard playing card, so they fit card sleeves; slip one in front of an old playing card and it stands up to a whole campaign.

      Works with

      Spell cards for the same character are on the Spell Planner. The Loot Generator sends a hoard's magic items here, and the Character Builder sheet has a 🎴 Cards button.
